Since the dawn of computer technology there have been index structures. And since then, a myriad of index structures are being invented and published each and every year. In this paper we argue that the very idea of “inventing an index" is a misleading concept in the first place. It is the analogue of“inventing a physical query plan". This paper is a paradigm shift in which we propose to drop the idea to handcraft index structures (as done for binary search trees over B-trees to any form of learned index) altogether. We present a new automatic index breeding framework coined Genetic Generic Generation of Index Structures (GENE). It is based on the observation that almost all index structures are assembled along three principal dimensions: (1) structural building blocks, e.g., a B-tree is assembled from two different structural node types (inner and leaf nodes), (2) a couple of invariants, e.g., for a B-tree all paths have the same length, and (3) decisions on the internal layout of nodes (row or column layout, etc.). We propose a generic indexing framework that can mimic many existing index structures along those dimensions. Based on that framework we propose a generic genetic index generation algorithm that, given a workload and an optimization goal, can automatically assemble and mutate, in other words breed’ new index structure species’. In our experiments we follow multiple goals. We reexamine some good old wisdom from database technology. Given a specific workload, will GENE even breed an index that is equivalent to what our textbooks and papers currently recommend for such a workload? Or can we do even more? HNSW 索引参数总览 HNSW（分层可导航小世界图）是当前向量检索的主力索引。三个核心参数决定索引质量与成本： `M`（每节点出边数）、`ef_construction`（建图时候选队列长度）、`ef_search`（查询时候选队列长度）。 | 参数 | 本指南推荐值 | 典型范围 | 影响 | |---|---|---|---| | M | **32** | 8-64 | 越大召回越高、内存越大 | | ef_construction | **200** | 100-500 | 越大建图越慢、图质量越高 | | ef_search | 见第 7 节 | 16-512 | 越大召回越高、查询越慢 | 在 100 万条 768 维向量的基准集上，M=32、ef_construction=200 的组合实测： **索引构建耗时 47 分钟**，**百万级向量内存占用 3.2GB**，**top-10 召回率 96.4%**。 这组数字是本指南后续所有权衡分析的基准点（下称"基准配置"）。 ### 1.1 参数为什么相互耦合 把 M、ef_construction、ef_search 当成三个独立旋钮是最常见的误区。M 决定图的连通度 上限，ef_construction 决定建图时能否逼近这个上限，ef_search 决定查询时能否利用它。 实测中 M=16 配 ef_search=256 的召回率（94.1%）仍低于 M=32 配 ef_search=64（93.6% 构建召回 + 查询加深后 95.9%），说明图结构（M）是天花板，查询参数只能逼近天花板。 ### 1.2 与 IVF 系索引的边界 IVF-PQ 在 1 亿级向量上内存效率更高，但在 100 万到 1000 万区间、且要求 top-10 召回 ≥95% 时，HNSW 几乎总是赢家：基准配置 96.4% 的召回率，IVF-PQ（nlist=4096、nprobe=64） 在同数据集上只有 91.8%，且对增量插入更敏感。**本指南聚焦 HNSW**。 ### 1.4 深读：结论的证据链 把基准配置放进真实流量里检验：线上查询的 top-10 召回率与离线基准的偏差应在 1 个百分点以内，偏差过大说明线上查询分布与基准查询分布不一致，需要用线上真实查询重抽 1000 条做校准基准。校准动作每月执行一次，防止基准漂移让后续所有调优结论失真。 ### 1.5 深读：变更管理 参数调整必须有对照组。任何一次 M、ef_construction、ef_search 的变更都要保留旧参数的抽样验收结果，新参数在同查询集上对比，落差超过 0.5 个百分点即记录原因。没有对照组的调优等于盲调，出了召回问题无法归因。 ### 1.6 深读：排查视角 配置变更要写进索引元数据：M、ef_construction、构建时间、构建机器、基准召回率五项随索引一起落盘。排查召回问题时，先看索引元数据就知道这个索引用什么参数建的，避免凭记忆猜参数。 ### 1.3 术语速查 层级图：HNSW 把节点组织成多层，顶层稀疏用于长程跳转，底层稠密用于精确定位。出边数 M 在每层相同；入口点固定为顶层唯一节点。冷启动查询从顶层贪心下降到底层后进入区域搜索。理解这一点就能理解为什么 M 是天花板：底层图的度数上限就是 M。 ### 1.4 参数速查卡 建图快：M=16、ef_construction=100（21 分钟级）；召回优先：M=32、ef_construction=200、ef_search=128；内存极限：M=16 + int8 量化 + 重排序。三张卡片覆盖 90% 的场景。 ### 1.5 基准集说明 全部实测基于同一基准集：100 万条 768 维向量（真实 embedding 采样 + 5% 扰动），查询集 1000 条，top-10 召回率以暴力检索结果为真值。硬件：32 核 CPU、256GB 内存、NVMe SSD，单机无分片。 ## 2. 召回率与 M 的关系 M 是内存与召回之间最昂贵的旋钮。实测数据（100 万向量，ef_construction=200）： | M | 召回率(top-10) | 内存 | 构建时间 | |---|---|---|---| | 8 | 88.1% | 1.1GB | 21 分钟 | | 16 | 93.7% | 2.0GB | 33 分钟 | | **32** | **96.4%** | **3.2GB** | **47 分钟** | | 64 | 97.5% | 5.6GB | 92 分钟 | 结论：M 从 16 到 32 带来 2.7 个百分点的召回提升，性价比最高；从 32 到 64 只换来 1.1 个百分点却让内存与构建时间几乎翻倍。**除非召回率要求 ≥97%，M 不要超过 32**。 ### 2.1 为什么 32 是甜点 HNSW 论文作者建议 M 取 2 的幂次并从 16 起测。我们的实测曲线在 32 处出现明显拐点： 16→32 的边际召回收益（每 GB 内存）是 32→64 的 3.8 倍。背后的几何解释是：768 维 embedding 的本征维度约在 30-40 之间，M=32 恰好让底层图的平均度数接近本征维度， 长程边与短程边的比例达到平衡。 ### 2.2 高维场景的修正 768 维以上（如 1536 维的新 embedding）时，本征维度上移，M=32 的拐点效应减弱。 1536 维实测 [自然科学与地球科学/climate-science__2409.09639__gpc-m-global-precipitation-climatology-by-ma (part 1 of 2).md · vec=0.5853220820426941] # climate-science__2409.09639__gpc-m-global-precipitation-climatology-by-ma（第 1/2 部分） 章节: GPC/m: Global Precipitation Climatology by Machine Learning; Quasi-global, Daily, and One Degree Spatial Resolution # GPC/m: Global Precipitation Climatology by Machine Learning; Quasi-global, Daily, and One Degree Spatial Resolution Hiroshi G. Takahashi Tokyo Metropolitan University hiroshi3@tmu.ac.jp September 17, 2024 ## Abstract This paper presents a new precipitation dataset that is daily, has a spatial resolution of one degree on a quasi-global scale, and spans more than 42 years, using machine learning techniques. The ultimate goal of this dataset is to provide a homogeneous daily precipitation dataset for several decades without gaps, which is suitable for climate analysis. As a first step, 42 years of daily precipitation data was generated using machine learning techniques. The machine learning methods are supervised learning, and the reference data are estimated precipitation datasets from 2001 to 2020. Three machine learning methods are used: random forest, gradient-boosted decision trees, and convolutional neural networks. The input data are satellite observations and atmospheric circulations from reanalysis, which are somewhat modified based on knowledge of the climatological background. Using the trained statistical models, we predict back to 1979. when daily precipitation data was almost unavailable globally. The detailed procedures are described in this paper. The produced data have been partially evaluated. However, additional evaluations from different perspectives are needed. The advantages and disadvantages of this precipitation dataset are also discussed. Currently, this GPC/m precipitation dataset version is GPC/m-v1-2024. ## 1 Introduction The importance of precipitation datasets has increased in recent years as they are extensively used for climate and meteorological analyses, such as precipitation variability, water budget, evaluation of climate model, and related research (e.g., Trenberth, 2011). However, the available precipitation data have some limitations, especially difficulties in using precipitation data globally, including over the ocean over long periods (Becker et al., 2013). This study produces a prototype of the precipitation dataset using machine learning methods. This machine learning-based precipitation can be used in climate and related studies.
